identityNotes: 카드캡터 사쿠라 / 카드캡터 체리 are localization aliases, but Clear Card, films, OVA and the original TV series remain separate works.
Laftel original Cardcaptor Cherry 15060 explicitly expired; related current Clear Card and movie catalog entries do not prove original TV availability.
Re:Zero director cut, season2 parts, later seasons and Frozen Bond movie are distinct editions; original Laftel33227 is expired.
Nia Liston official Laftel47452 and Aniplus3960 both use the long subtitle. Short-title matching needs corroborating metadata, not arbitrary prefix matching.
Laftel Apothecary41714 and Dinner42767 are registered metadata-only entries with viewing=false and noepisodes, not playable catalog positives.
Aniplus Frieren detail3011 visibly directs users to Laftel for viewing. Its official detail page is not proof of playable content on Aniplus itself.
All public catalog results are timestamped observations, not subscribed KR playback entitlement.
User typo 떄 normalized to 때 only in test label; do not blindly correct product title identities.
Netflix director's cut, recap specials, seasonal IDs, Cardcaptor series/film/Clear Card must stay distinct.
Prime public document title may be Season 2; source title needs visible metadata validation.
Crunchyroll can return a generic homepage at a valid series URL; never trust it as title.
Korean Apple TV catalog includes external-provider listings and is not Apple TV subscription availability.
